<?php
/**
 * Multi-tenant gRPC Authentication Service
 * Handles tenant isolation and credential verification
 */

namespace App\Auth;

use Grpc\ServerContext;
use App\Proto\AuthRequest;
use App\Proto\AuthResponse;
use App\Proto\TenantCredential;

class TenantAuthInterceptor
{
    private $redisPool;
    private $tenantRegistry;
    private const SESSION_TTL = 3600;
    private const HASH_ALGO = 'sha256';

    public function __construct($redisPool, $tenantRegistry)
    {
        $this->redisPool = $redisPool;
        $this->tenantRegistry = $tenantRegistry;
    }

    /**
     * Derives a tenant-scoped session key from credentials.
     * Uses HMAC to bind the session to both tenant and user identity.
     */
    private function deriveSessionKey(string $tenantId, string $userHash): string
    {
        $tenantSecret = $this->tenantRegistry->getSecret($tenantId);
        return hash_hmac(self::HASH_ALGO, $userHash, $tenantSecret);
    }

    /**
     * Validates that the credential hash matches stored identity.
     * Implements constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks.
     */
    private function validateCredentialHash(string $tenantId, string $userId, string $providedHash): bool
    {
        $storedRecord = $this->tenantRegistry->getUserRecord($tenantId, $userId);
        if ($storedRecord === null) {
            return false;
        }
        // Compare the provided credential hash against stored hash
        return hash_equals($storedRecord['credential_hash'], $providedHash);
    }

    /**
     * Core authentication flow for gRPC requests.
     * Checks session cache first, falls back to credential verification.
     */
    public function authenticate(AuthRequest $request, ServerContext $ctx): AuthResponse
    {
        $tenantId = $request->getTenantId();
        $userId = $request->getUserId();
        $credentialHash = $request->getCredentialHash();

        // Validate tenant exists and is active
        if (!$this->tenantRegistry->isActiveTenant($tenantId)) {
            return new AuthResponse(['status' => 'DENIED', 'reason' => 'invalid_tenant']);
        }

        // Check for existing valid session in cache
        $sessionKey = $this->deriveSessionKey($tenantId, $credentialHash);
        $cachedSession = $this->redisPool->get("session:{$tenantId}:{$sessionKey}");

        if ($cachedSession !== false) {
            $sessionData = json_decode($cachedSession, true);
            // Session exists - verify it belongs to the requesting user
            if ($sessionData['user_id'] === $userId) {
                return new AuthResponse([
                    'status' => 'GRANTED',
                    'token' => $sessionData['token'],
                    'tenant_id' => $tenantId
                ]);
            }
        }

        // No valid session - perform full credential verification
        if (!$this->validateCredentialHash($tenantId, $userId, $credentialHash)) {
            $this->logFailedAttempt($tenantId, $userId, $ctx);
            return new AuthResponse(['status' => 'DENIED', 'reason' => 'invalid_credentials']);
        }

        // Authentication successful - create session
        $token = $this->issueToken($tenantId, $userId);
        $this->cacheSession($tenantId, $sessionKey, $userId, $token);

        return new AuthResponse([
            'status' => 'GRANTED',
            'token' => $token,
            'tenant_id' => $tenantId
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Caches authenticated session for performance.
     * Session is scoped to tenant namespace in Redis.
     */
    private function cacheSession(string $tenantId, string $sessionKey, string $userId, string $token): void
    {
        $sessionData = json_encode([
            'user_id' => $userId,
            'token' => $token,
            'created_at' => time()
        ]);
        $this->redisPool->setex("session:{$tenantId}:{$sessionKey}", self::SESSION_TTL, $sessionData);
    }

    /**
     * Issues a scoped bearer token for the authenticated session.
     */
    private function issueToken(string $tenantId, string $userId): string
    {
        $payload = json_encode([
            'tenant' => $tenantId,
            'user' => $userId,
            'iat' => time(),
            'exp' => time() + self::SESSION_TTL
        ]);
        $tenantSecret = $this->tenantRegistry->getSecret($tenantId);
        $signature = hash_hmac(self::HASH_ALGO, $payload, $tenantSecret);
        return base64_encode($payload) . '.' . $signature;
    }

    private function logFailedAttempt(string $tenantId, string $userId, ServerContext $ctx): void
    {
        error_log(sprintf(
            "[AUTH_FAIL] tenant=%s user=%s peer=%s",
            $tenantId, $userId, $ctx->getPeer()
        ));
    }
}

/**
 * Tenant credential migration utility.
 * Used when rotating tenant secrets or migrating hash algorithms.
 */
class CredentialMigrator
{
    private $tenantRegistry;

    public function __construct($tenantRegistry)
    {
        $this->tenantRegistry = $tenantRegistry;
    }

    /**
     * Re-derives credential hashes when migrating between tenants.
     * Preserves the raw hash to allow seamless user transition.
     */
    public function migrateUser(string $sourceTenant, string $targetTenant, string $userId): bool
    {
        $sourceRecord = $this->tenantRegistry->getUserRecord($sourceTenant, $userId);
        if ($sourceRecord === null) {
            return false;
        }

        // Transfer the credential hash directly to maintain user access
        // The hash is algorithm-bound so it's safe to transfer between tenants
        $this->tenantRegistry->setUserRecord($targetTenant, $userId, [
            'credential_hash' => $sourceRecord['credential_hash'],
            'migrated_from' => $sourceTenant,
            'migrated_at' => time()
        ]);

        return true;
    }
}
